explication: Qlib is an AI-oriented quantitative investment platform. A researcher configures a workflow, which loads market data, constructs processed features and labels, trains predictive or reinforcement-learning models, creates portfolio decisions, and evaluates them through backtesting and reports. Online management and hyperparameter tuning extend this path into production operation. The tree and README establish these capabilities; sampled source most directly confirms data fetching, file storage, online retraining, and tuner dispatch, so several broader orchestration links remain intentionally high-level.
